mechanism: Trailing TF (e.g. M1 or M15) supplies statistical optimal SL/TP levels with holding time fixed to 1 bar; new SL must lie between min breakeven (open±commission/swap/slippage in points) and SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL max, and only improve prior SL. Smaller TFTS → scalping sensitivity; larger → trend.

mechanism: Treat each position’s floating ProfitPoint as player capital; choose SL/TP maximizing Bernoulli moral expectation given take-profit probability p, with hard constraint that SL < Profit (and slip-aware). Moves to BE earlier than simple trail—suited to scalping.
data_needed: Position profit in points; estimated p of TP hit; slip bound; same min/max SL envelope.

mechanism: Theil–Sen: k=median of all pairwise (y_j−y_i)/(j−i), b=median of y−k·index; MAD of residuals → robust σ for channel (±n·MAD) and slope fan (±StDevAngle). Combines to Gann-like channel+fan; more robust than OLS under non-Gaussian price noise.
data_needed: Price series over iPeriod; StDevAngle/StDevB multipliers.
